CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sellerpilot_private.smartstore_category_source_sorted_records(p_value jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(value order by
    sellerpilot_private.smartstore_category_source_canonical(value)
      collate "C"), '[]'::jsonb)
  from pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(p_value) item(value)
